title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

Your Mission at plancraft

We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day.

Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers.

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build.

Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate.

Your Responsibilities

  • AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo.

  • The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently.

  • Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value.

  • How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start:

  • Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions.

  • Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in.

  • Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team.

  • Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count.

Your Profile

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Prior experience building AI or ML capabilities is a huge plus — including work from before the LLM era — but it's not a fixed requirement. Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and release verification across our web platforms and supporting microservices. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring zero-regression web releases, fast user conversion funnel performance, and seamless multi-service integrations for millions of students.

Working closely with frontend and backend teams across a modern multi-service architecture, you will shift quality left, auditing Figma specs before sprint commitments, reviewing PRs, and maintaining continuous quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test suites using Playwright and TypeScript, integrated directly into GitLab CI pipelines.

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

💡 Your Mission: Build the financial engine for our next stage of growth

As a Finance Engineer, you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally.

This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering. You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions.

At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function. You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements.

We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them — someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better.

 

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize.

  • Drive financial reporting and analysis, building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions.

  • Own and improve operational finance processes, including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation.

  • Build and improve our Finance stack, connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work.

  • Support our international growth, working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations.

     

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role, with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience.

  • Strong analytical and commercial thinking, with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations.

  • A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable.

  • Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently.

  • Modern finance systems & tools: Hands-on experience working with ERP/accounting systems and modern Finance tools. Experience with Spendesk, BI/reporting tools, or workflow automation platforms is a plus.

  • High ownership and a builder mentality: you are comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, communicating with stakeholders, and building processes from scratch. Fluent in English and conversational in German.

     

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

description:
About AIWI

AIWI is an independent non-profit that exists to ensure that insiders at frontier AI companies can speak up safely and effectively when they see something that should be addressed. We do this by integrating the ecosystem of lawyers, AI researchers, AI advocacy organizations, journalists, regulators, and policymakers who can act on what they learn.

Tasks

About the role

You will own all of AIWI's technology: architecture, implementation, deployment, security, and maintenance. Delivery will be hands-on and you will manage a budget for executing items defined on your roadmap. You will work closely with the founders, Head of Security, and translate requirements from our operations, research, and advocacy teams into working systems. The work is demanding, sensitive, and consequential; conviction in our mission is essential.

Areas of Ownership

  1. Internal tooling. We operate in a highly sensitive environment. Many commercial SaaS products, and hosted AI models in particular, do not meet our security and data sovereignty requirements. You will build and operate our self-hosted, primarily OSS stack end to end: A secure CRM tailored to our needs, state-of-the-art self-hosted AI models and agent systems integrated into knowledge management, call recording, communication tooling, other OSS software we self host, and in-house development of news tracking solutions. If you are excited about designing architecture that allows air-gapping and decentralized access, this role is for you.
  2. External-facing technology. You take offerings from prototype to production end-to-end: Zero-knowledge proof solutions for anonymous coordination, interactive scenario simulators, or automated legislation trackers. Projects can span months or require rapid 3-day delivery. You will also oversee the tech-side of our website. Your solutions will directly drive the impact and safety of AI whistleblowers.

This means you will frequently handle multiple projects simultaneously. You will be the first non-volunteer engineer working on AIWI dedicated technology. Across all areas, security is foundational. You will work closely here with our Head of Security.

Given nature of role, onsite London preferred; remote considered

Requirements

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.

title: Product Analytics Manager
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About The Role.

You will lead a team of ~3-4 product analysts for our Customer Growth and Lifecycle domain, owning narrative and insights and driving sustainable customer customer growth. You will be a thought partner with a Director of Product and you will influence roadmap and product decisions, and also work cross-functionally day-to-day with Marketing, Risk, Finance and the rest of Data.


The scope runs from acquisition source and sign-up, through credit approval, activation, repeat usage, arrears behaviour, retention, and cohort profitability. You'll need to be as comfortable talking about loss rates and payback periods as you are about conversion funnels and retention curves, and tie everything we’re doing to commercial outcomes.

You will be a hands-on leader solving some of the most complex customer and business problems, while also managing a team of ~3-4 product analysts. You will be someone who thrives at using complex data and intuition to drive business outcomes, ensuring data is a core driver of company strategy.

What you’ll be doing day to day.

  • Own the analytics strategy for the Customer Lifecycle domain - from acquisition quality through activation, retention, and cohort profitability - translating the company-wide analytics vision into a focused plan for your team.

  • Operate horizontally across Lifecycle squads: your analysts are already embedded, so your job is to connect the dots, spot patterns across teams, and ensure the collective effort ladders up to domain commercial goals.

  • Know the key commercial drivers inside out - cohort payback, contribution margin, funnel economics, risk-adjusted value - so you can direct work with conviction and challenge outputs with authority.

  • Build experimentation capability within the domain pragmatically - establish clear hypotheses, decision criteria, and honest readouts as the norm for your teams.

  • Increase stakeholder self-sufficiency through dashboards and shared frameworks - freeing your analysts from reactive requests and shifting their time towards high-value proactive work.

  • Grow and focus your team - coach analysts, raise the technical bar, and create clarity on what good looks like for the domain.

  • Be the primary analytics partner for Lifecycle product leadership - earning trust by consistently surfacing what matters, not just what's been asked for.

  • Raise the standard of evidence in domain product decisions - moving from opinion-led to evidence-led, one decision at a time.

 

What We're Looking For.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and embrace change as an opportunity.

  • 6+ years in product analytics or insight-focussed roles (start-up or scale-up pace) and 2+ years leading a team of analysts.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present complex findings succinctly.

  • You're comfortable with credit risk concepts: loss rates, approval rates, unit economics. You don't need to be a risk modeller, but you can't be allergic to the topic.

  • Strong technical foundation in analytics with advanced SQL. You can model data, design experiments, and have a proper technical conversation if required

  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and tactical levels, able to “zoom in” on critical insights while maintaining a holistic view.

  • You've built experimentation programmes - not just run one-off tests, but established how a team thinks about evidence.

  • You're opinionated about what matters, but you update your views when the data says otherwise.

 

Bonus skills.

  • Experience in payments, regulated environments, or financial environments.

  • You've worked with Snowflake, dbt, Looker, or a similar modern stack.

We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

This is not a "write test cases and file tickets" role. You co-own product quality end-to-end, tell engineering teams where the gaps are, and build the systems and practices that let us ship with confidence. Faster, not slower.
You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release.

Our Stack

  • Flutter & TypeScript
  • Appium, BrowserStack
  • Testmo for test case management
  • GCP, GitHub Actions, Datadog
  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro
Key Responsibilities
  • Own quality across our mobile products end-to-end: test strategy, execution, and production monitoring
  • Work embedded in one or two cross-functional product teams and shape quality practices with engineers, product, and design
  • Find the gaps in our current testing approach and close them
  • Grow and maintain our automated test suite (Appium / BrowserStack). Keep it fast, stable, trusted, and focused on critical user journeys
  • Advise engineers on testing strategy and testability early, at the design stage, not after the build
  • Push AI-driven QA beyond test generation: bring in autonomous exploratory testing, intelligent orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows
  • Build QA feedback loops that are tightly integrated with development. Quality should be a real-time signal, not a gate at the end
  • Keep test infrastructure healthy: less flakiness, faster runs, results the whole team can act on
  • Use AI tools wherever they make you and the team more effective, and figure out where autonomous QA can reduce repetitive manual work while preserving human judgment where it matters


Dein Profil

  • 5+ years of QA experience across manual testing, automation, and test strategy.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile test automation (Appium or comparable) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack or similar)
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (we use GitHub Actions) and using quality signals to support rapid, reliable releases
  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, client-server interactions, and API integrations, with a feel for common mobile failure patterns
  • You understand the SDLC and can design test strategies around how complex products fail
  • Practical experience leveraging AI in QA workflows such as exploratory testing, test case design, defect analysis, and autonomous testing agents. Or you have a clear vision for it and can show you've been building in that direction
  • You care about user journeys and real-world scenarios, not just code coverage numbers
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You figure out the path forward when there's no playbook
  • Clear communicator in written and spoken English
Bonus points for:
  • German language skills
  • Experience with energy systems, IoT, or climate tech
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs or AI agents in a QA or DevEx context


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

title: Software Development Engineer II, Routing Tiling
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Routing Tiling team builds and operates the data infrastructure that powers navigation at global scale. We process raw geospatial data from OpenStreetMap and commercial providers into highly optimized routing tiles, integrate real-time traffic signals, and deliver this data reliably to millions of users. Our systems directly support navigation experiences used by major automotive partners such as BMW. The team operates at the intersection of large-scale data processing, distributed systems, and geospatial intelligence, with a strong emphasis on automation, data quality, and operational excellence.

Read about Mapbox Navigation on our blog: https://blog.mapbox.com/tagged/navigation

What You'll Do

As an Engineer on the Routing Tiling team, you will design, build, and operate critical components of the routing data pipeline. In this role, you can expect to:

  • Develop and scale systems that transform raw map data into performant, production-ready routing tiles

  • Improve data freshness and processing efficiency, reducing pipeline latency from days to hours

  • Integrate real-time traffic and map updates to enhance routing accuracy and guidance quality

  • Ensure high reliability and availability of routing data delivered to global users and partners

  • Build automated systems that maintain data integrity, consistency, and quality at scale

Employment Type: Full-time

Weekly Hours: 40 hours per week - 1 week on call every 5 weeks

Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years of backend focused experience

  • 3+ engineering modern Rust applications in a commercial or open-source development environment

  • 3+ years of working with distributed systems. Preferably with AWS based tools or Azure/GCP alternatives

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Rust/Go/Python)
description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer to help design and build the next generation of our global online learning platform, empowering users worldwide to master languages and new skills through interactive courses. In this role, you will take ownership of core services, designing resilient, high-performance microservices. You will work in an agile, parallel engineering environment with Claude Code woven into your daily workflow.

You will work cross-functionally with mobile and web teams - providing backend services, API contracts, and architectural guidance - while enjoying high autonomy and low bureaucratic friction. Best of all, you will work primarily on greenfield services, building modern, clean backend systems with no legacy debt.

 

What you'll do

  • Architecture: Design and implement highly performant, scalable, and resilient microservices from scratch using PostgreSQL and AWS.

  • Core Tech Stack: Utilize Rust as your primary language, while strategically integrating Go and Python for specific services or data workloads.

  • API Design: Build robust, clean APIs (gRPC, REST) to ensure seamless integration for parallel mobile and web engineering teams.

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Actively integrate advanced tools like Claude Code into your daily GitHub and development workflow to maximize code quality and speed.

  • Clean Code Standards: Champion and apply best practices for type safety, concurrency, and high test coverage in a distributed system.

 

Who you are

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional backend development experience, with a proven track record in microservices and relational databases (PostgreSQL).

  • Deep Tech Skills: Strong, production-proven experience with Rust (including ownership model, lifetimes, and the async ecosystem like Tokio).

  • Polyglot Mindset: Solid proficiency in Go and/or Python to build complementary services where needed.

  • Modern Workflow: Proficiency with GitHub for version control, code reviews, and collaborating across parallel teams.

  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of distributed systems, AWS services, messaging patterns, and database optimization.

  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to mentor peers and align with parallel engineering teams.

 

Why you should join us

  • AI-Native by Default: We build with Claude - code generation, API design, code reviews, architectural documentation, and debugging. You get first-class AI tooling that takes the boilerplate off your plate, so your time goes to system design, judgment, and the genuinely hard backend problems.

  • Pure Greenfield: No legacy code, no technical debt - you own the design of core services and domains for our global EdTech platform.

  • Infrastructure Support: A dedicated Platform Engineering team handles provisioning and CI/CD so you can build on AWS services directly.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

description:

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to shape and evolve the core platform architecture that powers n8n — creating scalable, configurable foundations across execution, infrastructure, and frontend platform so 80+ product engineers and our open-source community can build confidently across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

Working across our platform teams, you’ll bring architectural coherence to the systems they jointly own and help us make the right long-term technical decisions as n8n scales:

Architectural direction across Core Platform

  • Drive architecture across the two Core Platform teams, ensuring execution, infrastructure, data, and frontend platform systems evolve as a coherent whole rather than independent components.

  • Design highly adaptable backend foundations that support different workloads, deployment models, shared product team needs, and future scale without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Partner with the FE platform workstream on core canvas architecture, real-time communication, performance, plugin contracts, and other platform primitives used by product teams.

Execution, distributed systems & data foundations

  • Evolve core subsystems including durable workflow execution and state, orchestration, queue and task distribution, worker management, scheduling, and horizontal scaling.

  • Design for correctness and resilience across distributed environments, including failure modes, idempotency, state transitions, tenant isolation, and reliability guarantees.

  • Shape our data and persistence architecture, including database scaling, sharding, migration strategies, deployment abstractions, and long-term operational maintainability.

Platform architecture & engineering enablement

  • Lead consequential technical decisions through clear proposals and RFCs, making trade-offs explicit and aligning engineers and stakeholders around durable solutions.

  • Define stable platform interfaces and abstractions that reduce coupling, support safe migrations, and make the platform easier for feature teams to build on.

  • Mentor engineers across all engineering teams through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, raising the bar for architecture, system design, and maintainability.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏗️ Staff-level architectural ownership: You have a track record of leading architecture across multiple systems or teams, including migrations, re-architectures, or foundational platform initiatives with long-term organizational impact.

  • 🧠 Systems thinking: You reason deeply about invariants, correctness, failure modes, boundaries, and trade-offs, and you’re comfortable making decisions where there is no obviously perfect solution.

  • ⚙️ Configurable systems at scale: You’ve designed highly configurable, adaptable systems that serve multiple use cases or operating modes without becoming brittle or excessively complex.

  • 🌐 Distributed systems depth: You’ve designed and operated distributed systems involving concepts such as asynchronous processing, idempotency, state machines, queues, consistency, and resilience.

  • 🗄️ Data architecture at scale: You’ve worked on data-intensive systems where persistence, performance, isolation, migrations, and operational reliability were meaningful architectural concerns.

  • 🛠️ TypeScript & Node.js depth: You have strong TypeScript experience and have built substantial backend systems with Node.js beyond conventional CRUD applications.

  • 🤝 Cross-team technical leadership: You influence through technical judgment, clear communication, RFCs, design reviews, and mentorship, helping multiple teams converge on better solutions without relying on formal authority.

  • 🧱 Platform enablement mindset: You care about creating clear contracts, abstractions, and developer experiences that allow other engineers to move faster and more safely.

  • 🧹 Long-horizon engineering: You’re energized by modularization, migrations, refactoring, and evolving existing systems while keeping the product and engineering organization moving.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧰 Workflow, orchestration or devtools experience: You’ve worked on workflow engines, orchestration platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure-heavy SaaS products.

  • 🖥️ Frontend platform architecture: You’ve worked with architecture-heavy frontend systems such as canvas applications, plugin systems, real-time applications, web workers, or complex rendering environments.

  • 🧾 Durable execution patterns: You’ve designed or operated systems using event sourcing, sagas, durable execution, or related state-management patterns.

  • 👥 Multi-tenant architecture: You’ve designed systems where tenant isolation, resource management, data boundaries, or noisy-neighbour concerns were important.

  • 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand the additional pressure around public contracts and backward compatibility.

  • 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve operated systems at meaningful scale or worked in environments where reliability and architectural decisions had broad customer impact.

  • 🧩 Monolith → modular migrations: You’ve decomposed monolithic systems or led incremental architectural migrations without preventing product teams from continuing to ship.

  • ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve designed products that need to work consistently across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments.

  • 🔭 Observability mindset: You think about instrumentation, debugging, incident response, rollout safety, and operability as part of system design rather than an afterthought.

  • 🧪 Strong CS grounding: You bring deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts, consistency models, consensus, formal methods, or similarly rigorous approaches to system correctness.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the foundations that almost every product experience depends on. You’ll have influence across two Core Platform teams, helping shape how our execution engine, infrastructure, data architecture, and frontend platform evolve together as both our product and engineering organization scale.

This is a Staff role with real architectural leverage: you’ll tackle problems that span team boundaries, evolve systems that already operate at meaningful scale, and create platform capabilities that make 80+ engineers more effective. You’ll do that in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, thoughtful experimentation, and engineers who influence through strong technical judgment rather than hierarchy.

title: Werkstudent / Praktikant (m/w/d) | Development & AI Engineering für SAP Business AI
description:
Du willst nicht in einer Sandbox mit Testdaten üben, sondern KI-Agenten bauen, die im echten Unternehmen produktiv laufen? Dann lies weiter.

Wir sind nfaculty: eine SAP-Boutique, SAP Gold Partner, spezialisiert auf SAP Cloud ERP, die SAP Business AI Platform und die SAP Business Data Cloud. Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische Unternehmen, die ihre Prozesse in der Cloud standardisieren — und darauf etwas Eigenes brauchen: Agenten, die den Monatsabschluss beschleunigen, Abweichungen erklären, Bestellprozesse übernehmen.

Genau diese Agenten entwickeln wir. Mit CAP auf der SAP BTP, mit SAP AI Core und Joule, mit Frontier-Modellen und den Werkzeugen, die es dafür heute wirklich gibt — nicht mit denen von vor drei Jahren.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung: jemanden, der Lust hat, tief in die Technik zu gehen. Du schreibst Code, der beim Kunden ankommt, und Du bekommst von Anfang an gesagt, wofür er gut ist. Ob als Werkstudent über mehrere Semester, im Pflicht- oder freiwilligen Praktikum ab drei Monaten oder mit Abschlussarbeit im Thema — alles drei geht, sag uns einfach, was zu Deinem Studium passt.

Umfang und Vergütung: 16–20 Stunden pro Woche als Werkstudent, in der Prüfungszeit reduzierbar. Vollzeit im Praktikum. 17 € pro Stunde. Remote-first, deutschlandweit.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Services und Anwendungen mit SAP CAP (Node.js/TypeScript oder Java) auf der SAP Business Technology Platform — vom Datenmodell über den Service bis zum Deployment.
  • Du baust an unseren KI-Agenten mit: SAP AI Core und Generative AI Hub, Joule-Erweiterungen, Tool-Calling, MCP-Server, RAG auf Unternehmensdaten. Prompt- und Kontextdesign gehören dazu — das ist heute Engineering-Arbeit, nicht Textarbeit.
  • Du machst Agenten messbar: Du baust kleine Evaluations- und Test-Setups, damit wir belegen können, dass ein Agent zuverlässig arbeitet, statt es zu behaupten.
  • Du baust Frontends, wo sie gebraucht werden: SAPUI5/Fiori Elements oder eine leichtgewichtige Web-App.
  • Du automatisierst: CI/CD, Deployment-Pipelines, Skripte, die uns Handarbeit sparen.
  • Du prototypisierst neue Ideen für unser eigenes Produktportfolio — manchmal in zwei Tagen von null auf demofähig.
  • Du dokumentierst und zeigst, was Du gebaut hast: im Team, gelegentlich auch beim Kunden.

Was Du nicht machst: Excel-Listen pflegen, Präsentationen formatieren, Kaffee holen, Ticket-Triage. Wir sind ein kleines Team — wir haben keine Zeit, Dich zu parken.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst Du

  • Laufendes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik oder etwas Vergleichbarem — ab dem dritten Semester
  • Solide Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer Sprache: JavaScript/TypeScript, Java oder Python. Wichtiger als die Sprache ist, dass Du eigenständig ein Problem in Code übersetzen kannst.
  • Grundverständnis von Git, APIs (REST/OData) und relationalen Datenbanken (SQL)
  • Echtes Interesse an KI — Du hast schon selbst mit LLMs, Agenten oder Coding-Assistenten gearbeitet, nicht nur darüber gelesen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist. Bei uns gibt es niemanden, der Dir täglich Aufgaben zuteilt.
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sicher in verbaler und schriftlicher Kommunikation

Schön, wenn Du es hast — aber kein Ausschlusskriterium

  • Erste Berührung mit SAP BTP, CAP, HANA Cloud, SAPUI5 oder ABAP
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (SAP BTP, Azure, AWS, GCP), Docker, Kubernetes
  • Ein eigenes Projekt, ein GitHub-Profil oder ein Hackathon, über das Du erzählen kannst
  • Grundverständnis betriebswirtschaftlicher Prozesse (Finance, Einkauf, Vertrieb)

Was Du ausdrücklich nicht brauchst: SAP-Vorkenntnisse. Die bringen wir Dir bei — schneller, als Du denkst, weil Du direkt an echten Systemen arbeitest.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung ab Woche zwei. Dein Code geht in Kundenprojekte, nicht in ein Ablagefach.
  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Zwischenlayer, keine Matrix. Du sitzt in denselben Terminen wie die Seniors.
  • Frontier-KI-Modelle und ein eigenes Toolbudget. Wir arbeiten mit den aktuellen Modellen und Agenten-Tools — bezahlt, freigeschaltet, ohne Genehmigungsschleife.
  • Eine eigene Entwicklungsumgebung auf SAP BTP plus Zugang zu SAP Learning Hub und Zertifizierungen, die wir bezahlen. Die nimmst Du mit, egal wie es hier weitergeht.
  • MacBook, auch privat nutzbar, modernes Setup.
  • Remote-first, deutschlandweit. Arbeitszeit rund ums Studium, nicht umgekehrt — in der Prüfungsphase runterfahren ist normal und kein Gesprächsthema.
  • Ein fester Mentor aus dem Team und ein wöchentlicher 1:1. Du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen, aber auch nicht an der Hand geführt.
  • Perspektive: Abschlussarbeit im Thema, danach Einstieg als Consultant oder Developer. Das ist bei uns der Regelweg, nicht die Ausnahme.Teamtage vor Ort mit dem gesamten Team, Reise und Unterkunft von uns.

Klartext, damit Du weißt, worauf Du Dich einlässt: Wir sind ein kleines Team. Es gibt kein Onboarding-Portal, kein Werkstudentenprogramm mit 40 anderen in Deinem Jahrgang und keine perfekt dokumentierte Codebase. Es gibt Kunden mit echten Problemen, erfahrene Kollegen, die Dir antworten, und viel Raum, Dinge selbst zu entscheiden.

Wenn Du eine klar abgesteckte Aufgabe suchst, die Du sechs Monate lang abarbeitest, wirst Du hier nicht glücklich. Wenn Du im nächsten Jahr mehr über KI, Cloud-Entwicklung und Unternehmensprozesse lernen willst als in jedem Praktikum bei einem Konzern — dann sollten wir reden.

Bewirb Dich unkompliziert: Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben. Stattdessen zwei Sätze im Bewerbungsformular zu der Frage: Was hast Du zuletzt selbst gebaut oder ausprobiert — und was hat dabei nicht funktioniert? Das interessiert uns mehr als jede Note.

Wir melden uns innerhalb einer Woche. Der Prozess besteht aus einem Kennenlerngespräch und einem fachlichen Gespräch, in dem wir gemeinsam auf ein konkretes technisches Problem schauen. Kein Assessment-Theater, keine fünf Runden.

title: Senior Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/d), you are a strategic operator, sparring partner, system builder, and connector helping plancraft make better decisions, align around priorities, and turn strategy into coordinated execution.

Working closely with our Strategy & Operations team, Management, and functional leaders, you operate across three core areas: insights & decision groundwork, strategy translation & integrated planning, and execution enablement & company operating systems. You bring structure to complex company-wide topics, connect the right stakeholders and information, and turn ambiguity into pragmatic systems that work in practice.

As plancraft enters its next growth phase on the path to Series C, this role is central to strengthening how we steer and scale the organization. You take end-to-end ownership of critical company systems and selected high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from diagnosing a problem and designing the target setup to stakeholder alignment, implementation, tooling, communication, and continuous improvement.

The role combines two operating modes: running the engine by operating and improving recurring company systems, and upgrading the engine by building the next capabilities and operating models plancraft needs. Your work creates the backbone for greater clarity, alignment, speed, and follow-through across the organization.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner and connector: Build strong relationships across Management and Leadership, connect perspectives across the organization, and help bring the right people, information, and decisions together at the right time.

  • Strengthen company decision-making: Connect relevant internal and external inputs, create transparency, and turn complexity into clear insights and decision groundwork for Management and key stakeholders.

  • Translate strategy into coordinated execution: Design and facilitate the systems that connect company direction with priorities, plans, goals, ownership, dependencies, and follow-through.

  • Evolve planning, steering & Management systems: Help shape annual planning, goal-setting, company steering, Management rhythms, decision forums, information flows, and follow-up to enable better focus and faster, well-informed decisions.

  • Build scalable company operating systems: Improve shared processes, communication formats, tooling, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and ways of working that reduce coordination overhead and increase organizational effectiveness.

  • Lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives: Structure ambiguous company-critical problems, orchestrate stakeholders and workstreams, and drive initiatives from diagnosis and design through implementation and adoption.

  • Create clarity and durable impact: Improve visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and decision needs, while building pragmatic systems that are adopted by their users and continue to work beyond individual projects.

YOUR PROFILE

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a strong generalist in strategy, business operations or transformation environments, e.g. as Chief of Staff, Strategy & Operations Manager, in PMO or in a Founders office.

  • Proven ability to structure complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable solutions.

  • Experience designing or improving systems, processes, or operating models in fast-scaling organizations.

  • Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives or programs end-to-end (incl. PMO discipline).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, translating complexity into clear insights and recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills (written & verbal) with experience creating executive-ready materials.

  • Confident stakeholder management skills, especially with senior leadership

  • High ownership, autonomy, and execution strength: you create momentum without needing detailed instructions.

  • Strong judgment to balance strategic ambition and output quality with pragmatic, scalable solutions.

  • Experience working closely with founders or senior leadership in fast-paced environments.

  • Hands-on exposure to areas like planning systems, company operating models and change initiatives.

  • Comfortable using AI tools and building basic workflows and agents.

  • Ability to structure documentation and knowledge environments using tools such as Notion.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

  • Willingness to regularly join the team and key stakeholders in Hamburg for selected workshops and working sessions. For remote setups within Germany, regular Hamburg presence approximately every 4–8 weeks is expected.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience across multiple startup or scale-up stages and different leadership setups.

  • Experience designing and facilitating high-stakes workshops and Management sessions.

  • Admin level experience in Notion and Slack.

  • Fluent German skills.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

This role is for a strategic operator, systems thinker, builder, and connector who can zoom out to understand the bigger picture and get hands-on to move things forward.

You are someone who:

  • naturally connects the dots across data, business context, and organizational dynamics;

  • turns ambiguity into clear, scalable systems that create meaningful company-wide impact;

  • combines strategic thinking with a high-agency, get-things-done mindset;

  • builds pragmatic solutions that work in practice and can scale beyond the initial problem;

  • is comfortable with high leadership exposure while also doing much of the important work behind the scenes;

  • builds trust quickly, communicates clearly, and challenges constructively when needed;

  • takes ownership of open threads and knows when to align, decide, or escalate.

You are energized by turning complexity into clarity, scalable systems, and forward motion.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, France, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion.   • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Clinical Pharmacist at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

At AIOS Tech (Bolt Pharmacy), we're building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. Right now it's akin to assisted self-driving (and improving every day), so humans are prescribing with AI assisting their workflows.

You'll join our growing team of Independent Prescribers, working through GLP-1 weight-management consultations day in, day out. You understand that a great patient experience means catching everything you need to prescribe safely and confidently first time - not sending someone back and forth for information you should have picked up on intake.

You'll assess each patient on their own merits: the comorbidity, the interacting medication, the case that needs a second look, and make the right call. You’ll never compromise on safety or accuracy.

You'll:

  • Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing for every patient on your list

  • Take full ownership of the clinical quality, safety and accuracy of your own consultations and records

  • Flag anything that needs escalating—a red flag, a near miss, a protocol gap—clearly and quickly

  • Follow, and help sharpen, our clinical protocols as they evolve

This role is suited to a confident, forward-thinking prescriber with sound clinical judgement, excellent attention to detail, and a strong commitment to patient safety.

Great performance in this role means your patients are safe, your records hold up to audit, and you're working through a full, steady caseload without ever cutting corners. If you nail this role, you'll be a strong candidate for more senior clinical positions as we grow.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement - full-time (40h) preferred, part-time (20h+) available - fully remote/WFH or hybrid onsite in Blackburn.

You’ll report directly to your team lead.

You’ll also work most closely with:

  • Saim Dalvi (UK Clinical Lead)

  • Mobeen Nawaz (Interim Clinical Ops Lead)

  • Phuong Nguyen (Superintendent Pharmacist)

Key Responsibilities

  • Prescribing: Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing for every patient you see — assessing suitability, comorbidities and contraindications before you write anything.

  • Consultations: Run detailed, efficient consultations that capture everything you need the first time, so patients aren't stuck in back-and-forth messiness.

  • Monitoring: Track treatment response and side effects across your caseload, and adjust care promptly and safely.

  • Escalation: Recognise what's outside your remit, and escalate red flags, near misses or complex cases to your Senior Clinician Team Lead quickly and clearly.

  • Documentation: Keep accurate, concise and contemporaneous clinical records that hold up to audit.

  • Governance: Contribute to clinical audits, incident learning and quality improvement when asked.

  • Collaboration: Work smoothly with customer support, operational and technology teams to keep the service safe and moving in service of our patient base.

Need to Have

  • Registration: GPhC-registered pharmacist with an Independent Prescriber (IP) annotation, held for at least 1 year.

  • GLP-1 Confidence: You've prescribed weight-management, GLP-1s or a closely related area — comorbidities and polypharmacy don't throw you off protocol.

  • Clinical Reasoning: You think clearly and quickly within a protocol-led service.

  • Safety Mindset: Patient safety and quality are non-negotiable for you. Red flags don't get past you.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, including confident patient counselling.

  • Pace: Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-volume, protocol-led environment, and you don't let volume compromise accuracy.

  • Digital Literacy: Confident using electronic health records and remote consultation platforms.

  • Flexibility: Willing to support evening or weekend rotas when needed. With sufficient notice, you work the hours that our patients need you to work so they can be served without long wait times and unnecessary friction.

Nice to Have

  • Consultation Modes: Experience with asynchronous, telephone and/or video consultations.

  • Specialist Training: Additional training in obesity or weight management, such as SCOPE certification.

  • Postgraduate: A postgraduate clinical diploma or equivalent.

  • Complex Patients: Comfortable managing patients with diabetes, cardiovascular disease, renal impairment or polypharmacy.

  • Governance Experience: Some experience contributing to clinical audits, incident investigations or quality-improvement projects.

  • Protocols: Exposure to developing SOPs, clinical protocols or prescribing pathways.

  • Startup Pace: Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, ideally in the weight loss space.

  • Growth Mindset: An interest in eventually mentoring or supporting more junior colleagues as you grow with us.

  • Systems: Familiarity with clinical support and customer management systems.

    🎯 “You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”

Training and onboarding

  • Training is delivered completely remotely

  • The duration of training is a minimum of 2 days, with scheduling negotiable depending on experience and prior exposure to GLP-1 prescribing or digital health services.

  • Ongoing mentoring and support are provided throughout your induction and practice.

  • Following successful completion of the training period, the role transitions to remote working.

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: £30 - £35/hr inc equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well:

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps

  • Coaching: free biweekly health coaching

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.
